blocks.content: Rounding helps us give a number that is close enough, but easier to use.
Look at the hundreds digit: 5 or more rounds up, 4 or less rounds down.

steps: 4 is less than 5, so we round down.

blocks.explain: The hundreds digit is 7, so we round up.

blocks.question: Round 8,512 to the nearest thousand.
blocks.explain: The hundreds digit is 5, so round up to 9,000.
